description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating three token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating three times that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
